snippet.title: 【ENG】KOF XV DLC｜TEAM GAROU｜Trailer
snippet.description:
A total of 12 DLC characters are planned to release this year after KOF XV launches on Feb 17th, 2022. The first wave of fighters is Team 1 (Team GAROU) which will release in March, with the second wave Team 2 (Team SOUTH TOWN) releasing in May. Team 3 releases sometime during summer with Team 4 releasing in autumn. Each team is comprised of 3 fighters, so the total number added onto the current roster of 39 means players can expect to fight with 51 star-studded characters in KOF XV!
